large_unit: define measurement integrity constraints for productive ratio
constraints: Do not report tool-call latency as direct active work unless measurement can separate it reliably.
When direct active_work_sec is unavailable, report goal_directed_window_sec/ratio separately rather than relabeling it productive_ratio.
Count substantive units only when they add a new decision, measurement, or durable validation result.
Terminal close operations belong to completion envelope, not productive task time.
